name: GET all students
expected_response: JSON array of student records with fields (id, register_number, name, email, department, ...)
purpose: Verify retrieval of all registered students in the system.

name: GET one student
expected_response: JSON object of student with id=1 (register_number='CS2023001', name='Alexander Vance', ...)
purpose: Verify retrieval of a single student by primary key ID.

name: POST valid student
expected_response: Created student object with assigned id (e.g., id=11, register_number='CS2023099')
purpose: Verify successful registration of a new student with valid attributes.

name: POST student with missing required field
expected_response: {"error": "Missing required field: register_number, name, email, and department are required"}

actual_response.error: Missing required field: register_number, name, email, and department are required

purpose: Verify system rejects student creation when a mandatory field (name) is missing.

name: POST duplicate register number
expected_response: {"error": "Student with register number CS2023001 already exists"}

actual_response.error: Student with register number CS2023001 already exists

purpose: Verify system enforces unique constraint on student register_number.

name: POST invalid email
expected_response: {"error": "Invalid email address format"}
purpose: Verify email format validation prevents malformed emails.

name: PUT valid student
expected_response: Updated student object with id=19, name="Jordan Mitchell-Updated", section="A"
purpose: Verify modification of existing student details by ID.

name: PUT invalid student ID
expected_response: {"error": "Student not found"}
purpose: Verify update fails gracefully with 404 for a non-existent student ID.

name: DELETE valid student
expected_response: Empty response body with HTTP 204 No Content
purpose: Verify successful deletion of an existing student record.

name: DELETE invalid student ID
expected_response: {"error": "Student not found"}
purpose: Verify deletion fails with 404 when attempting to delete a non-existent student ID.

name: GET all subjects
expected_response: JSON array of subject objects with fields (id, subject_code, subject_name, department, credits, faculty_name)
purpose: Verify retrieval of all curriculum subjects.

name: GET one subject
expected_response: JSON object of subject with id=1 (subject_code="CS501", subject_name="Data Structures & Algorithms")
purpose: Verify retrieval of a single subject record by ID.

name: POST valid subject
expected_response: Created subject object with assigned id (e.g., id=8, subject_code="CS509")
purpose: Verify creation of a new subject course with valid attributes.

name: POST missing subject name
expected_response: {"error": "subject_name is required"}
purpose: Verify validation rejects subject creation without a subject name.

name: POST duplicate subject code
expected_response: {"error": "Subject with code CS501 already exists"}

actual_response.error: Subject with code CS501 already exists

purpose: Verify uniqueness constraint enforcement on subject_code.

name: PUT valid subject
expected_response: Updated subject object with id=14, subject_name="AI & Autonomous Systems"
purpose: Verify modification of existing subject course attributes.

name: PUT invalid subject ID
expected_response: {"error": "Subject not found"}
purpose: Verify update fails gracefully with 404 for a non-existent subject ID.

name: DELETE valid subject
expected_response: Empty response body with HTTP 204 No Content
purpose: Verify deletion of an existing subject by ID.

name: DELETE invalid subject ID
expected_response: {"error": "Subject not found"}
purpose: Verify deletion returns 404 for a non-existent subject ID.

name: GET all attendance records
expected_response: JSON array of attendance records with joined student and subject details
purpose: Verify retrieval of all attendance logs.

name: GET one attendance record
expected_response: JSON object of attendance record with id=1
purpose: Verify retrieval of an individual attendance record by ID.

name: POST valid attendance
expected_response: Created attendance record with id, student details, subject details, status="Present"
purpose: Verify marking valid attendance for a student in a subject on a date.

name: POST missing student
expected_response: {"error": "student is required"}
purpose: Verify rejection when student ID is omitted.

name: POST missing subject
expected_response: {"error": "subject is required"}
purpose: Verify rejection when subject ID is omitted.

name: POST invalid status
expected_response: {"error": "Invalid status. Allowed values: Present, Absent, Late"}

actual_response.error: Invalid status. Allowed values: Present, Absent, Late

purpose: Verify validation constraint on status values (only Present, Absent, Late allowed).

name: POST duplicate attendance
expected_response: {"error": "Attendance record already exists for this student, subject, and date", "existing_id": ...}

actual_response.error: Attendance record already exists for this student, subject, and date

purpose: Verify rejection of duplicate attendance marking for same student, subject, and date.

name: PUT valid attendance
expected_response: Updated attendance record with id=112, status="Late", remarks="Traffic delay approved by HOD"
purpose: Verify updating attendance status and remarks for an existing record.

name: PUT invalid attendance ID
expected_response: {"error": "Attendance record not found"}
purpose: Verify update returns 404 for a non-existent attendance ID.

name: DELETE valid attendance
expected_response: Empty response body with HTTP 204 No Content
purpose: Verify successful deletion of an attendance record.

name: DELETE invalid attendance ID
expected_response: {"error": "Attendance record not found"}
purpose: Verify deletion returns 404 for a non-existent attendance record ID.
